source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 18 (PDF 83-114), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Inheritance) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe Mendel's monohybrid cross for seed shape and explain its results in terms of alleles and the law of segregation. (4 marks)
(Mendel ka seed shape wala monohybrid cross bayan karein aur us ke nataij ki alleles aur law of segregation ke hawale se wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cross: Mendel ne true-breeding round beej wale matar ko wrinkled beej wale se cross kiya. Tamam F1 paude round beej wale the, is liye round dominant aur wrinkled (jo F1 mein zahir nahi hua) recessive hai. F1 ko self-pollinate kiya to F2 ke 1/4 beej wrinkled the: 3 dominant : 1 recessive. Yeh 3:1 asal mein 1:2:1 tha (1/4 pure-breeding dominant, 2/4 ghair pure-breeding dominant, 1/4 pure-breeding recessive).

Wazahat: sifaat 'factors' (genes) control karte hain. Har fard diploid hai aur har sifat ke do genes rakhta hai; gene ki mutabadil shaklein alleles hain. Aik jaise alleles = homozygous (RR, rr); mukhtalif = heterozygous (Rr), jis mein sirf dominant allele zahir hota hai.

Law of segregation: gametes bante waqt har gamete ko sirf aik allele ittefaqan milta hai. Is liye F1 (Rr) R aur r gametes banata hai; in ke ittefaqi milap se 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr, yani 3 round : 1 wrinkled.

book_ref.quote: When he crossed a true-breeding round-seeded plant with wrinkled-seeded plant

blocks.prompt:
2 Mendel's ideas were later linked with chromosomes. (i) State the chromosomal theory of inheritance and name the scientists linked with it. (ii) Explain the testcross with the example of seed shape. (4 marks)
(Mendel ke khayalat baad mein chromosomes se jore gaye. (i) Chromosomal theory of inheritance bayan karein aur us se mutalliq scientists ke naam likhein. (ii) Seed shape ki misaal se testcross ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Chromosomal theory (1 number): 1900 mein Karl Correns ne Mendel ka kaam dobara dhoonda aur heredity mein chromosomes ka kirdar bataya; 1902 mein Walter Sutton ne nazariya pesh kiya: genes chromosomes par khaas jagahon par hain, aur meiosis mein chromosomes ka rawaiya Mendel ke qawaneen ki wazahat karta hai.

(ii) Testcross (3 number): is se maloom hota hai ke dominant phenotype homozygous hai ya heterozygous; use recessive phenotype se cross karte hain. Round paudha RR ya Rr ho sakta hai, wrinkled hamesha rr. Round ko rr se cross karte hain:
• Agar RR hai to sirf R gametes, is liye tamam aulad round (Rr).
• Agar Rr hai to R aur r gametes, is liye aulad round (Rr) aur wrinkled (rr) 1:1 mein.
Is tarah aulad naa-maloom genotype bata deti hai.

book_ref.quote: A round-seeded plant may be RR (homozygous) or Rr (heterozygous)

blocks.prompt:
3 Independent assortment does not always hold. (i) Explain how independent assortment acts as a source of variations. (ii) Describe its limitations. (4 marks)
(Independent assortment hamesha lagu nahi hota. (i) Wazahat karein ke independent assortment variations ka zariya kaise hai. (ii) Is ki hudood (limitations) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Variations ka zariya (2 number): independent assortment gamete bante waqt alleles ko milata hai; mukhtalif chromosomes par mukhtalif traits ke alleles azadana alag hote hain, is liye aik sifat (aankh ka rang) doosri (baalon ki banawat) par asar nahi karti. Yeh is liye hota hai ke meiosis mein homologous jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain aur maan baap ke alleles ke mukhtalif combinations bante hain; insaan mein aik gamete mein 8 million (2²³) se zyada, har gamete munfarid. Fertilization munfarid gametes ko munfarid zygote mein jorti hai; yeh milawat genetic tanawwo paida karti hai jo species ko dhalne mein madad deti hai.

(ii) Hudood (2 number):
1. Linked genes: aik chromosome par qareeb genes aksar ikatthe jate hain (gene linkage).
2. Chromosome crossover: meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ka tabadla mutawaqqa ratio badal deta hai.
3. Epistasis: aik gene ka asar doosre genes badal ya daba dete hain.
4. Pleiotropy: aik gene kai sifaat control karta hai aur ratios bigaar sakta hai.
5. Mahaul ka asar: bohat se phenotypes mahaul se mutassir hote hain.

book_ref.quote: This random alignment causes different combinations of maternal and paternal alleles in gametes

blocks.prompt:
4 A pea plant RrYy (round yellow) is crossed with a plant Rryy (round green), and 480 seeds are obtained. Using the product rule, find the expected number of each phenotype. (4 marks)
(RrYy (round yellow) matar ke paude ka Rryy (round green) se cross hota hai aur 480 beej milte hain. Product rule se har phenotype ki mutawaqqa tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har gene ko alag dekhein, phir azad probabilities ko zarb dein (product rule) aur 480 se zarb karein.

book_ref.quote: In a F1 dihybrid plant (RrYy), seed shape has alleles R, r and seed colour has Y, y

steps: Seed shape, Rr × Rr: P(round) = 3/4, P(wrinkled) = 1/4.
Seed colour, Yy × yy: gametes Y, y × y, is liye P(yellow, Yy) = 1/2, P(green, yy) = 1/2.
Wrinkled yellow = (1/4) × (1/2) = 1/8; wrinkled green = (1/4) × (1/2) = 1/8.
blocks.final_answer: 180 round yellow, 180 round green, 60 wrinkled yellow, 60 wrinkled green (ratio 3:3:1:1).

blocks.prompt:
5 In the cross AaBbCc × AaBbCc (three genes assorting independently), find the probability of an offspring that is (a) AABBCC, (b) aabbcc, (c) AaBbCc. Use the product rule, and the sum rule where needed. (4 marks)
(AaBbCc × AaBbCc cross mein (teen genes azadana) aulad ki probability nikalein jo (a) AABBCC, (b) aabbcc, (c) AaBbCc ho. Product rule aur zaroorat ho to sum rule istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har gene ki probability aik gene ke cross se nikalein, phir teen azad genes ke liye zarb karein.

book_ref.quote: So, probability of round yellow offspring = (3/4) × (3/4) = 9/16

steps: Aik gene, Aa × Aa: har parent A ya a 1/2 probability se deta hai.
P(Aa): male se A + female se a, ya male se a + female se A; sum rule se 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2.

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain co-dominance with reference to the human MN blood group system, giving its alleles, genotypes, antigens and phenotypes. (4 marks)
(Insaani MN blood group system ke hawale se co-dominance ki wazahat karein; alleles, genotypes, antigens aur phenotypes likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Co-dominance: heterozygous fard mein gene jore ke dono alleles bina milawat ya aik doosre ko chhupaye poori tarah zahir hote hain, is liye dono alleles ki paidawar heterozygote ke phenotype mein ikatthi nazar aati hai.

MN system: is ke do alleles hain, Lᴹ (M antigen banata hai) aur Lᴺ (N antigen banata hai). 'L' Landsteiner aur Levine ke liye hai jinhon ne 1927 mein system daryaft kiya. Ise MNS system bhi kehte hain kyunke MN aur S/s ke genes aik chromosome par linked hain.

Lᴹ aur Lᴺ co-dominant hain, is liye dono alleles hon to RBCs par dono antigens aate hain. Teen soorten:

book_ref.quote: The human MN blood group shows codominance, where both alleles are equally expressed

blocks.prompt:
7 The ABO system is a multiple allelic system. (i) What is a multiple allelic system? Name the alleles of the ABO system. (ii) Explain the principle of transfusion in the ABO system with its exceptions. (4 marks)
(ABO system multiple allelic system hai. (i) Multiple allelic system kya hai? ABO ke alleles ke naam likhein. (ii) ABO system mein transfusion ka usool aur us ki mustasniyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (1 number) Multiple allelic system tab hai jab population mein gene ke do se zyada alleles hon, jis se zyada variation aata hai. ABO system gene I (chromosome 9 par) se control hota hai jis ke teen alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i hain; har shakhs mein sirf do hote hain.

(ii) (3 number) Har group ke plasma mein us antigen ki antibodies hain jo us mein nahi: A mein anti-B, B mein anti-A, AB mein koi nahi, O mein dono. Na-mawafiq groups ke transfusion mein recipient ki antibodies donor ke RBCs ke antigens par hamla kar ke RBCs jama deti hain (agglutination). Yeh hota hai:
• jab group A ko group B ka khoon mile aur is ka ulat;
• jab donor AB aur recipient A, B ya O ho.
Mustasniyat:
• O donor: is mein antigen-A ya antigen-B nahi, is liye A, B, AB ya O sab ko diya ja sakta hai (ABO ka universal donor).
• AB recipient: is mein anti-A ya anti-B nahi, is liye sab qismein le sakta hai (ABO ka universal recipient).

book_ref.quote: During blood transfusions between two incompatible (unmatching) blood groups

blocks.prompt:
8 A woman of blood group AB marries a man of blood group B whose mother was of blood group O. Find the man's genotype and the expected blood groups of their children with the probability of each. (4 marks)
(Blood group AB wali aurat ki shadi blood group B wale mard se hoti hai jis ki maan ka blood group O tha. Mard ka genotype aur bachchon ke mutawaqqa blood groups har aik ki probability ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Maan se mard ka genotype maloom karein, gametes likhein aur unhein milayein.

book_ref.quote: The Iᴬ allele produces antigen-A, the Iᴮ allele produces antigen-B

steps: Mard ki maan O (ii) thi, is liye us ne i diya; group B hone se mard Iᴮi hai.
Aurat AB = IᴬIᴮ: gametes Iᴬ aur Iᴮ (har aik 1/2). Mard Iᴮi: gametes Iᴮ aur i (har aik 1/2).
IᴬIᴮ (AB) = 1/4; Iᴬi (A) = 1/4; IᴮIᴮ (B) = 1/4; Iᴮi (B) = 1/4.
Sum rule se P(B) = 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2; koi bachcha O nahi ho sakta kyunke maan mein i nahi.
blocks.final_answer: Mard Iᴮi. Bachche: AB 1/4, A 1/4, B 1/2, O 0.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the Rh blood group system: its discovery, inheritance, and the principle of transfusion in the Rh system. (4 marks)
(Rh blood group system bayan karein: is ki daryaft, wirasat aur Rh system mein transfusion ka usool.)
blocks.explanation:
Daryaft: Rh insaanon ka doosra sab se ahem blood group system hai. Naam Rhesus bandar se hai jis mein Landsteiner ne 1930s mein pehli dafa is ka antigen paya. Yeh RBCs par Rh-antigen (Rh factor ya antigen-D) ki mojoodgi (Rh-positive) ya ghair mojoodgi (Rh-negative) par hai. Blood group mein dono systems likhe jate hain, jaise A-positive ya A-negative.

Wirasat: gene D ke do alleles hain. Dominant D Rh-antigen banata hai; recessive d nahi banata. Is liye DD aur Dd Rh-positive aur dd Rh-negative hain.

Transfusion: anti-A aur anti-B ke bar-aks Rh-negative logon mein anti-Rh antibodies qudrati tor par nahi hotin. Agar Rh-negative shakhs ko Rh-positive khoon mile to us ka jism anti-Rh antibodies banata hai jo diye gaye RBCs tabah karti hain aur saari umar rehti hain. Is liye O-negative (koi ABO ya Rh antigen nahi) asal universal donor aur AB-positive (koi anti-A, anti-B ya anti-Rh nahi) asal universal recipient hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the second most important blood group system in humans

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke d Rh-antigen ko rokta hai; asal mein d bas antigen nahi banata. Isi liye Dd log Rh-positive hain.

blocks.prompt:
10 An Rh-negative woman marries an Rh-positive man. Find the chance that a child is Rh-positive (at risk of erythroblastosis foetalis) when the man is (a) DD, (b) Dd. In case (b), what is the chance that all three of their children are Rh-negative? (4 marks)
(Rh-negative aurat ki shadi Rh-positive mard se hoti hai. Bachche ke Rh-positive (erythroblastosis foetalis ke khatre mein) hone ka imkan nikalein jab mard (a) DD, (b) Dd ho. (b) mein teeno bachchon ke Rh-negative hone ka imkan kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aurat ka genotype likhein, mard ke har mumkin genotype se cross karein, phir teen azad paidaishon ke liye product rule lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The dominant allele D forms the Rh-antigen

steps: Rh-negative aurat dd hai; us ke tamam ande d rakhte hain.
(a) DD × dd: tamam sperms D, is liye har bachcha Dd (Rh-positive): imkan 1 (100%).
(b) Dd × dd: sperms D ya d (har aik 1/2), is liye bachche Dd (Rh-positive) 1/2 aur dd (Rh-negative) 1/2.
Teen azad bachche sab dd: (1/2) × (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/8.

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the complications that erythroblastosis foetalis causes in the foetus and new-born, and explain how ABO incompatibility can sometimes protect the baby. (4 marks)
(Erythroblastosis foetalis foetus aur naumaulood mein jo pechidgiyan paida karta hai woh bayan karein, aur wazahat karein ke ABO incompatibility kabhi kabhi bachche ko kaise bachati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Mukhtasar wajah: Rh-negative maan (dd) jo Rh-positive bachcha uthaye, foetal khoon us ke khoon mein aane par anti-Rh antibodies banati hai; yeh placenta paar kar ke foetal RBCs tabah karti hain.

Pechidgiyan:
1. Foetus mein haemolytic anaemia (khoon ki kami) aur doosri sangeen pechidgiyan.
2. Shadeed soorat mein hamal girna ya murda paidaish.
3. Agar foetus zinda rahe to liver aur spleen zyada RBCs banane ki koshish mein barh jate hain.
4. RBCs tootne se bilirubin banta hai jo jama ho kar jaundice (peeli jild aur aankhein) karta hai.
5. Zyada bilirubin dimaghi cells ko nuqsan de sakta hai.
Zinda bachche ka khoon anti-Rh antibodies se paak Rh-negative khoon se badla jata hai.

ABO incompatibility se bachao: agar O-negative maan A-positive ya B-positive bachcha utha rahi ho to us ke khoon mein aane wale foetal RBCs ko us ki pehle se mojood anti-A ya anti-B antibodies jaldi tabah kar deti hain, is se pehle ke woh anti-Rh antibodies banaye.

book_ref.quote: In severe cases, destruction of foetal RBCs can cause miscarriage or stillbirth

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe polygenic inheritance with the example of human skin colour. (4 marks)
(Insaani jild ke rang ki misaal se polygenic inheritance bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polygenic inheritance: polygenic characters bohat se gene joron se control hote hain. In genes ke tamam alleles aik hi trait mein jama hone wale (additive) tareeqe se hissa dalte hain (kuch asar barhate, kuch ghatate), aur mila jula asar continuous variation wala aik trait banata hai (jaise qad, jild ka rang, wazan, zahanat).

Jild ka rang: melanin ki miqdar par hai; zyada melanin se gehri jild. Yeh taqreeban 60 genes se control hota hai, magar samajhne ke liye teen genes A, B, C lete hain. A, B, C zyada melanin; a, b, c kam melanin banate hain.
• AABBCC (bohat gehra) × aabbcc (bohat halka) se tamam bachche AaBbCc, darmiyani rang.
• AaBbCc × AaBbCc se bohat gehre se bohat halke tak range, ratio 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1.
AABBCC sab se gehra (zyada melanin) aur aabbcc sab se halka (kam melanin); bohat si darmiyani classes continuous variation deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Skin colour depends on the amount of melanin pigment

blocks.prompt:
13 Using the three-gene model of skin colour, a person AaBbCc marries a person aabbcc. Find the kinds of children by number of dark alleles (A, B, C) and their ratio. (4 marks)
(Jild ke rang ke teen-gene model se AaBbCc shakhs ki shadi aabbcc se hoti hai. Dark alleles (A, B, C) ki tadaad ke lehaz se bachchon ki qismein aur un ka ratio nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: aabbcc parent sirf abc gametes deta hai, is liye bachche ke tamam dark alleles AaBbCc parent ke gamete se aate hain.

book_ref.quote: AABBCC → darkest (maximum melanin)

steps: AaBbCc 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 qisam ke gametes banata hai, har aik 1/8.
3 dark alleles (ABC): 1 gamete → 1/8.
2 dark alleles (ABc, AbC, aBC): 3 gametes → 3/8; 1 dark allele (Abc, aBc, abC): 3 gametes → 3/8.
0 dark alleles (abc): 1 gamete → 1/8. Jama 1/8 + 3/8 + 3/8 + 1/8 = 1.
blocks.final_answer: Chaar classes, 3 : 2 : 1 : 0 dark alleles, ratio 1 : 3 : 3 : 1; koi AABBCC jitna gehra nahi.

blocks.prompt:
14 Gene interactions may be allelic or non-allelic. (i) Distinguish allelic and non-allelic interactions with examples. (ii) Explain the Bombay phenotype as an example of how one gene affects the expression of ABO genes. (4 marks)
(Genes ki interactions allelic ya non-allelic ho sakti hain. (i) Allelic aur non-allelic interactions mein misaalon ke saath farq karein. (ii) Bombay phenotype ki wazahat karein ke kaise aik gene ABO genes ke izhar par asar dalta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (2 number) Aksar traits genes ki aapas ki interactions se zahir hote hain. Allelic interactions mein aik hi gene ke alleles asar dalte hain (incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles). Non-allelic interactions mein mukhtalif loci par mukhtalif genes ke alleles asar dalte hain; aam misaal epistasis hai jis mein epistatic allele doosre gene ke hypostatic alleles ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai.

(ii) (2 number) Bombay phenotype: ABO genotypes ka izhar aik aur gene H par munhasir hai jo H substance banata hai, jo A aur B antigens ka kachcha maadda hai. Iᴬ aur Iᴮ ke enzymes H substance ko antigen-A aur antigen-B mein badalte hain. Jis mein Iᴬ aur Iᴮ hon magar genotype hh ho woh H substance nahi banata, is liye A ya B antigens nahi bante aur O phenotype hota hai. Yeh 1952 mein Bombay mein daryaft hua aur zyada tar India, Bangladesh, Pakistan aur Iran mein milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The expression of ABO genotypes also depends upon another gene i.e., H

blocks.prompt:
15 A black Labrador BbEe is crossed with a yellow Labrador Bbee. Find the expected ratio of black, brown and yellow puppies. (4 marks)
(Black Labrador BbEe ka yellow Labrador Bbee se cross hota hai. Black, brown aur yellow bachchon ka mutawaqqa ratio nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har gene ki probability alag nikalein, phir epistasis ke usool se milayein: har ee kutta yellow hai.

book_ref.quote: When two heterozygous black dogs (BbEe × BbEe) are crossed

steps: Gene B, Bb × Bb: P(B_, black pigment) = 3/4, P(bb, brown pigment) = 1/4.
Gene E, Ee × ee: P(Ee, pigment jama) = 1/2, P(ee, yellow) = 1/2.
Yellow (koi bhi ee) = 1/2 = 4/8. Jama 3/8 + 1/8 + 4/8 = 1.

blocks.prompt:
16 A white-flowered foxglove plant DdWw is crossed with a light red plant ddww. Find the expected ratio of white, dark red and light red flowers. (4 marks)
(White phool wale foxglove DdWw ka light red ddww se cross hota hai. White, dark red aur light red phoolon ka mutawaqqa ratio nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: ddww sirf dw gametes deta hai, is liye aulad DdWw ke chaar gametes se tay hoti hai; jis mein W ho woh white hai.

book_ref.quote: The heterozygous plant DdWw will have white flowers

steps: DdWw ke gametes: DW, Dw, dW, dw (har aik 1/4); ddww ke gametes: sirf dw.
Aulad: DdWw, Ddww, ddWw, ddww, har aik 1/4.
DdWw aur ddWw mein W hai jo pigment ko chhote dhabbon tak rokta hai: white = 2/4.
Ddww: D aur yaksan pigment = dark red (1/4); ddww: light red (1/4).

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain how gene linkage is detected by crosses, distinguishing unlinked genes, incomplete linkage and complete linkage. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke crosses se gene linkage kaise maloom kiya jata hai; unlinked genes, incomplete linkage aur complete linkage mein farq karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pas-e-manzar: hazaron genes mehdood chromosomes par hain (insaan mein taqreeban 20,000 genes 23 chromosomes par; Drosophila mein taqreeban 13,000 genes 4 par), is liye har chromosome par bohat se genes qatar mein hain. Aik chromosome ke genes linked hain; qareebi linked genes saath rehte hain, jabke mukhtalif chromosomes ya door door wale genes azadana assort hote hain.

Pehchan: crosses kar ke aulad mein phenotypes ki frequency dekhi jati hai. Parental combinations (parents jaise) ka recombinant (naye) combinations se muqabla hota hai. Linkage sirf bari tadaad mein aulad se dikhta hai; jitni zyada aulad, utna asal frequency ke qareeb.
1. Parental aur naye phenotypes barabar 1:1:1:1: genes linked nahi, azadana assort hote hain.
2. Parental zyada, naye kam: incomplete linkage; genes linked magar crossing over se alag ho sakte hain.
3. Sirf parental, koi naya nahi: complete linkage; genes bohat qareeb aur alag nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Gene linkage and its frequency can be studied by performing crosses

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the process of crossing over and explain its significance. (4 marks)
(Crossing over ka amal bayan karein aur us ki ahmiyat ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amal:
1. Gamete bante waqt (meiosis-I) homologous chromosomes crossing over se guzarte hain.
2. Do homologous chromosomes ke chromatids saath saath qatar banate hain.
3. Woh DNA ke hisse badalte hain; DNA strands waqai toot kar dobara jurte hain.
4. Crossing over ke baad homologous chromosomes aik doosre se alag ho jate hain.
5. Shamil chromatids mein wohi genes usi tarteeb mein rehte hain magar alleles nayi tarteeb mein hote hain.

Ahmiyat:
• Yeh linked genes ke recombination ka zimmedar hai, is liye linked genes alag ho sakte hain (incomplete linkage).
• Recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein ja kar gametes mein bohat tanawwo paida karte hain.
• Is tarah yeh genes ka recombination aur genetic variability paida karta hai; isi wajah se ratios independent assortment ke andaze se mukhtalif ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: During crossing over, the chromatids of two homologous chromosomes line up next to one another

blocks.prompt:
19 Sex is determined on the basis of karyotype. (i) Define karyotype, autosomes and sex chromosomes. (ii) Explain homogametic and heterogametic sexes with reference to humans, grasshopper and birds. (4 marks)
(Jins karyotype ki bunyad par tay hoti hai. (i) Karyotype, autosomes aur sex chromosomes ki definitions likhein. (ii) Insaan, grasshopper aur parindon ke hawale se homogametic aur heterogametic jinson ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (2 number) Karyotype cells mein chromosomes ke mukammal set ki shakal hai, un ki tadaad, size aur shakal samet. Aksar janwaron mein aik jore ke siwa tamam jore female aur male mein aik jaise hain. Dono mein aik jaise chromosomes autosomes hain; jo aik jora mukhtalif hai aur jins tay karta hai woh sex chromosomes hain.

(ii) (2 number)
• Insaan (XX-XY): females homogametic, tamam ande aik X wale; males heterogametic, aadhe X-sperm aur aadhe Y-sperm. X-sperm + anda = XX female; Y-sperm + anda = XY male.
• Grasshopper (XX-XO): mada (XX, 24 chromosomes) ke tamam ande X wale; nar (XO, 23 chromosomes) aadhe X-sperm aur aadhe nullo sperm (koi sex chromosome nahi). X-sperm se XX mada; nullo sperm se XO nar.
• Parinde (ZW-ZZ): mada (ZW) heterogametic, Z ande aur W ande banati hai; nar (ZZ) ke tamam sperms Z. Z anda nar deta hai; W anda mada.

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, males are heterogametic which means that they produce two types of sperm

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Y carrying egg' likha hai, magar parindon mein Y nahi hota. Mada dene wala anda W wala hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is embryonic screening? Describe the procedure of amniocentesis. (4 marks)
(Embryonic screening kya hai? Amniocentesis ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Embryonic screening: woh tareeqe jin se embryos mein genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghair mamooli tadaad check ki jati hai. Is mein ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis shamil hain.

Amniocentesis:
1. Yeh aam tor par hamal ke 15th se 20th hafte mein hota hai.
2. Aik lambi suyi amniotic sac mein dali jati hai.
3. Is dauran ultrasound probe foetus ko dhoondta aur kisi kharabi ko check karta hai.
4. Suyi kuch amniotic fluid kheenchti hai jis mein foetus ke cells hote hain.
5. Foetal cells culture medium mein rakh kar chromosomes ki ghair mamooli tadaad ke liye check kiye jate hain.

21 Red-green colour blindness is X-linked recessive. A colour-blind man marries a woman of normal vision who is a carrier. Find the expected phenotypes of their sons and daughters with probabilities. (4 marks)
(Red-green colour blindness X-linked recessive hai. Colour-blind mard ki shadi normal nazar wali carrier aurat se hoti hai. Un ke beton aur betiyon ke mutawaqqa phenotypes probabilities ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Alleles X chromosome par likhein (Xᶜ = colour-blind, X = normal); Y par allele nahi. Bete maan ka X lete hain; betiyan dono parents se aik aik X.

book_ref.quote: So, this trait will appear in all the males who possess its allele

steps: Mard XᶜY: sperms Xᶜ aur Y (har aik 1/2). Carrier aurat XXᶜ: ande X aur Xᶜ (har aik 1/2).
Betiyan (baap se Xᶜ): XXᶜ carrier normal nazar 1/2; XᶜXᶜ colour-blind 1/2.
Bete (baap se Y): XY normal 1/2; XᶜY colour-blind 1/2.
Kul mila kar aadhe bachche colour-blind (beton mein aik allele kaafi, betiyon mein do chahiye).
blocks.final_answer: Betiyan: 1/2 carriers (normal), 1/2 colour-blind. Bete: 1/2 normal, 1/2 colour-blind.

blocks.prompt:
22 Describe the inheritance of X-linked dominant traits and Y-linked traits in humans, with examples. (4 marks)
(Insaanon mein X-linked dominant traits aur Y-linked traits ki wirasat misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
X-linked dominant traits:
• Misalein: vitamin D-resistant rickets (haddiyon ka naram aur kamzor hona), Rett syndrome (bolne ki salahiyat ka khatma, haath ki baar baar harkat, chalne mein masla), Aicardi syndrome (dimagh ki ghair mamooli nashonuma).
• Mutassir heterozygous maan 50% aulad ko trait deti hai (homozygous maan sab ko).
• Mutassir baap tamam betiyon ko deta hai (woh us ka X leti hain) aur kisi bete ko nahi (woh us ka X nahi lete).
• Is liye yeh traits aurton mein zyada hain jin ke do X hain.

Y-linked traits:
• Y par X ke muqable mein kam genes hain, is liye Y-linked traits kam hain.
• In ke genes ke alleles X par nahi; yeh holandric (hemizygous) genes kehlate hain aur sirf Y ke non-homologous hisse par hain.
• Yeh sirf mardon mein aate hain aur sirf baap se bete ko jate hain.
• Misalein: hypertrichosis (kaan ki lau ke kinare par baal), porcupine man (jism par seedhe baal), paon ki ungliyon ka jurna.

book_ref.quote: Such traits are in equal ratio in females and males

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai X-linked dominant traits mard aur aurat mein barabar hain. Asal mein yeh aurton mein taqreeban dugne hain. Aur 50% sirf heterozygous maan par sahi hai; homozygous maan har bachche ko trait deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe the mechanism of normal blood clotting. Name the types of haemophilia with the clotting factor and mode of inheritance of each. (4 marks)
(Khoon jamne ka normal tareeqa bayan karein. Haemophilia ki qismon ke naam har aik ke clotting factor aur wirasat ke tareeqe ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khoon jamne ka normal tareeqa:
1. Chot par platelets wahan chipak kar platelet plug banate hain.
2. Active platelets aur zakhmi tissue clotting factors kharij karte hain.
3. Clotting factors chemical reactions (clotting cascade) karte hain jin mein soluble fibrinogen insoluble fibrin mein badalta hai.
4. Fibrin jaal banata hai jo khoon ke hisson ko phansa kar thos clot banata hai.
5. Fibrin ke dhaagon ki cross-linking se clot mazboot hota hai.
Tawazun bigre to ghair mamooli clotting (thrombosis) stroke aur heart attack kar sakti hai.

Haemophilia: chot ke baad khoon theek tarah nahi jamta, clotting factors ki kami, kharabi ya ghair mojoodgi ki wajah se. Qismein:

book_ref.quote: Blood clotting is a complex process that helps to prevent excessive bleeding when an injury occurs

blocks.prompt:
24 Describe trichromatic vision and the types of colour blindness (dichromacy and monochromacy). (4 marks)
(Trichromatic vision aur colour blindness ki qismein (dichromacy aur monochromacy) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Trichromatic vision: normal nazar walon ki retina mein teen qisam ke cone cells hain, har aik aik bunyadi rang ke liye hassas: red, green aur blue-sensitive cones. Har aik mein khaas pigment proteins, opsins, hain. Red aur green opsins ke genes X par aur blue opsin ka gene autosome 7 par hai. Opsins ke recessive alleles colour blindness paida karte hain.

Dichromacy: do bunyadi rangon ki pehchan aur teesre ka andhapan jis ka opsin ghayab ho:
• red-blindness (protanopia)
• green blindness (deuteranopia)
• blue-blindness (tritanopia)
Red-green colour blindness aam qisam hai jis mein red ya green opsin ghayab ya kharab hota hai.

Monochromacy (mukammal colour blindness): sirf aik rang ki pehchan aur do rangon ka andhapan jin ke opsins ghayab hon. Blue-cone monochromacy mein red aur green opsins nahi hote; red-cone aur green-cone monochromacy bohat kam hain.

Ilaj nahi; colour-blind glasses, khaas software aur colour discrimination training madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: These are red-sensitive cones, green-sensitive cones and blue-sensitive cones

blocks.prompt:
25 Describe Duchenne muscular dystrophy: its inheritance, cause, course of the disease and management. (4 marks)
(Duchenne muscular dystrophy bayan karein: is ki wirasat, wajah, bimari ka silsila aur ilaj.)
blocks.explanation:
Wirasat: muscular dystrophies 30 se zyada hain; Duchenne sab se aam hai. Yeh X-linked recessive hai, is liye mardon mein zyada. Taqreeban do tihai cases maan se aate hain; aik tihai nayi mutation se.

Wajah: jis mard ko recessive allele mile woh muscle protein dystrophin nahi bana sakta. Muscle fibres mar jate hain aur skeletal muscles kamzor ho kar toot-te hain, khaas tor par hips, pelvis, raanon aur pindliyon ke; baad mein kandhon, gardan, bazuon, saans aur dil ke muscles tak.

Silsila: yeh taqreeban chaar saal ki umar mein asar karti hai aur chalna shuru karne par zahir hoti hai. 10 saal tak braces ki zaroorat; 12 saal tak aksar chal nahi sakte aur wheelchair chahiye. Umar aam tor par 15 se 45 saal.

Ilaj (shifa nahi): physical therapy taqat, lachak aur harkat barqarar rakhti hai; corticosteroids thori muddat ki taqat dete hain; pain-killers dard kam karte hain; surgery joint contractures theek karti hai.

book_ref.quote: There are more than 30 disorders classified as muscular dystrophies
